subtheme: Making models smaller and faster without losing power

subsubthemes.name: Teaching smaller models with larger ones
subsubthemes.gist: Use a big trained model to teach a smaller model the same skills, so the small model thinks better without needing to learn from scratch.

subsubthemes.name: Adapting and tuning with minimal parameters
subsubthemes.gist: Add small trainable pieces to a frozen model instead of retraining everything, so you can customize it for new tasks without the cost of full training.

subsubthemes.name: Decoding faster through parallel and speculative methods
subsubthemes.gist: Generate multiple tokens at once or guess ahead and verify quickly, so the model produces answers in fewer steps without waiting.

subsubthemes.name: Routing work to specialist experts
subsubthemes.gist: Split the model into experts that handle different types of input, so the model can use only the relevant experts for each task instead of running all computations.

subsubthemes.name: Shrinking and compressing the model itself
subsubthemes.gist: Remove unnecessary weights, reduce precision, or prune unused tokens so the model takes less memory and runs faster on limited hardware.

subsubthemes.name: Building hybrid and adaptive models
subsubthemes.gist: Combine different architectures or attention types, or adaptively adjust computation based on input difficulty, so the model uses only the compute it needs.
